entry: **The on-disk layout, written event by event (`S04.persist-events`, `S04.resume`, `S04.callbacks`).** Through `control-sdk`, then from a program whose callback looks for each event's file as the event arrives. | **Callbacks (`S04.callbacks`).** Order is visualizer, then user callbacks in list order; user callbacks run after the event is stored, the visualizer before; an event whose write fails reaches no callback.

**Damaged event files (`S04.persist-events`).** A finished conversation is reopened after one change at a time to its `events/` folder: an empty file (what an interrupted write leaves), invalid JSON, a deleted file. The conversation reopens every time without an error: a deleted file is skipped and the other events reload; an empty or invalid file is read as a `ConversationErrorEvent` stand-in (code `UnreadableEventFile`) in the same place, so the event count is unchanged (`S05.event-log-recovery`).
**Which agent changes a resume accepts (`S04.resume-agent-compat`).** Removing a tool, removing a default tool and changing the agent class fail; adding a tool and changing the LLM work.

**An injected `FileStore` (`S04.custom-file-store`).** `LocalConversation(file_store=InMemoryFileStore(), persistence_dir=...)` writes only to the store, still reports the directory, and a second conversation reloads from the store.
**An exception inside `run()` (`S04.run-error`).** The model raises a plain `RuntimeError` (persisted conversation) and an `LLMAuthenticationError` (in memory).

**Close (`S04.close`).** Each conversation's terminal is a tmux server under the run's private `TMUX_TMPDIR`; the program counts the live ones. `close()` stops it, a second `close()` is a no-op, the object can be collected afterwards, `delete_on_close=False` still stops the terminal, `__del__` closes, and persisted files stay in every case.

**Pause (`S04.pause`).** A run of four `sleeper` steps is paused from another thread after the first observation; a pause while idle; a pause while an LLM call is in flight waits for that call and its action, then stops; `run()` resumes each time. | **Examples 09, 10, 11 and 12 (`S04.pause`, `S04.persist-events`, `S04.resume`, `S04.async-callback`, `S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-masking`, `S04.visualizer-default`).** Live; example 10 also needs `uvx` and network.

**An async program (`S04.async-callback`).** `run()` in an executor thread, events delivered to a coroutine on the main loop through `AsyncCallbackWrapper`. | **Examples 09, 10, 11 and 12 (`S04.pause`, `S04.persist-events`, `S04.resume`, `S04.async-callback`, `S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-masking`, `S04.visualizer-default`).** Live; example 10 also needs `uvx` and network.

**`arun()` and `interrupt()` (`S04.arun-interrupt`).** The model takes 30 s per call; `interrupt()` from another thread stops `arun()` at once without raising, then `run()` finishes the script. With no `arun()` in flight (idle, or a synchronous `run()`), `interrupt()` is a `pause()`. | **Examples 26, 48, 50 and 54 (`S04.visualizer-custom`, `S04.fork`, `S04.fork-branch`, `S04.title-and-tags`, `S04.arun-interrupt`, `S04.cancel-token`, `S04.goal-loop`).** Live.

**The cancellation token (`S04.cancel-token`).** One step with four 1-second `sleeper` calls, `tool_concurrency_limit=1`, interrupted during the first: the token is cancelled and the other three never start; the next run gets a new token. | **Examples 26, 48, 50 and 54 (`S04.visualizer-custom`, `S04.fork`, `S04.fork-branch`, `S04.title-and-tags`, `S04.arun-interrupt`, `S04.cancel-token`, `S04.goal-loop`).** Live.

**Secrets (`S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-constructor`, `S04.secrets-masking`).** `update_secrets` with a string and a `SecretSource` subclass, a key overwritten, and `Conversation(secrets=...)`; the agent echoes them in the terminal. | **Examples 09, 10, 11 and 12 (`S04.pause`, `S04.persist-events`, `S04.resume`, `S04.async-callback`, `S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-masking`, `S04.visualizer-default`).** Live; example 10 also needs `uvx` and network.

**Secrets (`S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-constructor`, `S04.secrets-masking`).** `update_secrets` with a string and a `SecretSource` subclass, a key overwritten, and `Conversation(secrets=...)`; the agent echoes them in the terminal.

**Secrets (`S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-constructor`, `S04.secrets-masking`).** `update_secrets` with a string and a `SecretSource` subclass, a key overwritten, and `Conversation(secrets=...)`; the agent echoes them in the terminal. | **Examples 09, 10, 11 and 12 (`S04.pause`, `S04.persist-events`, `S04.resume`, `S04.async-callback`, `S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-masking`, `S04.visualizer-default`).** Live; example 10 also needs `uvx` and network.

**Visualizers (`S04.visualizer-default`, `S04.visualizer-custom`).** The default prints Rich panels (with and without passing it), `None` prints nothing, an instance with `skip_user_messages=True` drops the user panel, and a `ConversationVisualizerBase` subclass receives every event. | **Examples 09, 10, 11 and 12 (`S04.pause`, `S04.persist-events`, `S04.resume`, `S04.async-callback`, `S04.secrets-update`, `S04.secrets-masking`, `S04.visualizer-default`).** Live; example 10 also needs `uvx` and network.

**Visualizers (`S04.visualizer-default`, `S04.visualizer-custom`).** The default prints Rich panels (with and without passing it), `None` prints nothing, an instance with `skip_user_messages=True` drops the user panel, and a `ConversationVisualizerBase` subclass receives every event. | **Examples 26, 48, 50 and 54 (`S04.visualizer-custom`, `S04.fork`, `S04.fork-branch`, `S04.title-and-tags`, `S04.arun-interrupt`, `S04.cancel-token`, `S04.goal-loop`).** Live.

**Fork (`S04.fork`).** A priced source run (0.28) is forked with tags, another agent and a title, which is accepted and ignored; the fork continues while the source stays as it was; a second fork keeps metrics and a chosen id; the fork reloads from disk. | **Examples 26, 48, 50 and 54 (`S04.visualizer-custom`, `S04.fork`, `S04.fork-branch`, `S04.title-and-tags`, `S04.arun-interrupt`, `S04.cancel-token`, `S04.goal-loop`).** Live.

**Branches (`S04.fork-branch`).** Each event's `parent_id` is the one before; `fork(from_event_id=first_answer)` copies three events; `navigate_to(first_answer)` then a new message starts a sibling branch; `navigate_to(None)` empties the active branch but keeps the log. | **Examples 26, 48, 50 and 54 (`S04.visualizer-custom`, `S04.fork`, `S04.fork-branch`, `S04.title-and-tags`, `S04.arun-interrupt`, `S04.cancel-token`, `S04.goal-loop`).** Live.

**The goal loop (`S04.goal-loop`).** `run_goal` with a scripted judge: incomplete then complete (the follow-up names what was missing), and a capped run whose last verdict cannot be parsed. | **Examples 26, 48, 50 and 54 (`S04.visualizer-custom`, `S04.fork`, `S04.fork-branch`, `S04.title-and-tags`, `S04.arun-interrupt`, `S04.cancel-token`, `S04.goal-loop`).** Live.

**Interactive terminal (`S04.interactive-terminal`).** With `no_change_timeout_seconds=3`, `python3` waits for input after 3 s and the next commands are typed into the REPL; a callback collects every LLM message, tool results included. A program waiting on `input()` is then answered the way the terminal tool tells the model to: `is_input=True`. | **Example 06 and integration test t07 (`S04.interactive-terminal`).** Live.

**Final response, title and tags (`S04.final-response`, `S04.title-and-tags`).** `get_agent_final_response` on finished conversations; `generate_title` from the agent's LLM, an explicit LLM, a reply with `<think>` reasoning, a failing LLM and no user message; tags kept on disk, bad keys and long values refused. | **A real model across a resume (`S04.factory`, `S04.resume`, `S04.final-response`).** Live; each `control-sdk` command reopens the conversation from disk.

**Final response, title and tags (`S04.final-response`, `S04.title-and-tags`).** `get_agent_final_response` on finished conversations; `generate_title` from the agent's LLM, an explicit LLM, a reply with `<think>` reasoning, a failing LLM and no user message; tags kept on disk, bad keys and long values refused. | **Examples 26, 48, 50 and 54 (`S04.visualizer-custom`, `S04.fork`, `S04.fork-branch`, `S04.title-and-tags`, `S04.arun-interrupt`, `S04.cancel-token`, `S04.goal-loop`).** Live.

**Conversation stats (`S04.stats`).** A priced conversation (two calls at 0.14) plus a second LLM in the conversation's registry, then a resume from disk. The snapshot form of stats update events is not reachable here: a local run never emits them.
